definitions.gloss: losers; the unsuccessful; those left behind
definitions.explanation: People seen as having failed in society's competition for money, career, or marriage; the opposite of {勝|か}ち{組|ぐみ}. A blunt, judgmental word, often used self-mockingly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{負|ま}け{組|ぐみ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think I'm one of life's losers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勝|か}ち{組|ぐみ}→勝ち組：32716_kachigumi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{負|ま}け{組|ぐみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦おかしい→おかしい：00875_okashii⟧。
examples.english: It's wrong to divide people into winners and losers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧や⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{負|ま}け{組|ぐみ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{決|き}めつけられて→決めつける：13267_kimetsukeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{案外|あんがい}→案外：01699_angai⟧⟦{幸|しあわ}せ→幸せ：02368_shiawase⟧だったり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: People may be written off as losers on the basis of income or marriage alone, yet they are often happier than you would think.

notes:
USAGE:
A word of the 2000s that spread with debates about inequality (⟦{格差|かくさ}{社会|しゃかい}→格差社会：19962_kakusashakai⟧). Calling someone {負|ま}け{組|ぐみ} to their face is insulting; it is more often said about oneself, half joking, or used in discussions that criticise the label.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{勝|か}ち{組|ぐみ}→勝ち組：32716_kachigumi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{負|ま}け{組|ぐみ}: winners and losers
- {負|ま}け{組|ぐみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to end up among the losers
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{負|ま}け{組|ぐみ}: a loser in life
